title: Instrument description (instrument.json)
description: A guitar or a bass that the guitarist or the bassist can hold. The GLB is skinned to a fixed GH3 rig profile of the band library; the game binds it to the rest pose of the band member that holds it.

profile.description: The rig profile of the GLB joints.

kind.description: guitar: the guitarist can select it. bass: the bassist can select it.

highway.description: Package path of a highway image (PNG; GH3 uses 512 x 1024). When the player selects the instrument for the player's role, the highway uses this image. Absent: the highway of the character (GH3).
